mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, process_type, bool_single_project, project_id, file_name, file_version, attachment__id, user_id, remark
mapper.select:
SELECT file.*, u.`name` user_name FROM `tech_artifact_process_file` AS file LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = file.user_id AND u.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_artifact_process_file_link link ON file.id = link.process_file_id AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE file.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND file.process_type = #{processType}
AND file.bool_single_project = #{boolSingleProject}
AND (file.project_id = #{projectId} or link.project_id = #{projectId})
AND file.file_name LIKE concat('%',#{fileName},'%')
AND link.structure_class_id = #{structureClassId}
AND link.`name` LIKE concat('%',#{name},'%')
AND link.serial_number LIKE concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
AND link.specification LIKE concat('%',#{specification},'%')
AND link.material LIKE concat('%',#{material},'%')
GROUP BY file.id ORDER BY file.id DESC
